name: AcExportXMLOtherFlags
description: Use with the ExportXML method to specify other behaviors associated with exporting to XML.

constants.name: acEmbedSchema
constants.description: Writes schema information into the document specified by the DataTarget argument; this value takes precedence over the SchemaTarget argument.

constants.name: acExcludePrimaryKeyAndIndexes
constants.description: Does not export primary key and index schema properties.

constants.name: acRunFromServer
constants.description: Creates an Active Server Pages (ASP) wrapper; otherwise, default is an HTML wrapper. Applies only when you are exporting reports.

constants.name: acLiveReportSource
constants.description: Creates a live link to a remote Microsoft SQL Server 2000 database. Valid only when you are exporting reports that are bound to a Microsoft SQL Server 2000 database.

constants.name: acPersistReportML
constants.description: Persists the exported object's ReportML information.

constants.name: acExportAllTableAndFieldProperties
constants.description: The exported schema contains properties of the table and its fields.
